pilot: Mozilla Human-Scale AI Incubator - local-model evaluation layer pilot

data.description: R DESeq2 1.42.0 results on Schnell et al. 2025 human PSC kidney organoid data (GEO GSE264217), LY294002 10uM 48h vs control, 6 samples. Columns: baseMean, log2FoldChange, padj per Ensembl gene.

ground_truth_rule: padj < 0.05 AND log2FC >= 1 -> UP; padj < 0.05 AND log2FC <= -1 -> DOWN; otherwise NO_CHANGE. Genes with padj NA are excluded.

sampling.positives: all UP and DOWN genes, capped at 150 by random sample if more
sampling.borderline_band: truth NO_CHANGE AND ((padj < 0.05 AND 0.7 <= |log2FC| < 1.0) OR (0.05 <= padj < 0.2 AND |log2FC| >= 1.0)); sample up to 60
sampling.presentation_order: all sampled cases shuffled with the same seed; model sees one gene at a time

model_presentation: Ensembl ID, baseMean, log2FoldChange, padj (as printed, 4 significant digits). No gene symbol, no condition information beyond the criteria text. The criteria in the prompt are exactly the ground-truth rule, stated in words.

model.name: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (GGUF Q4_K_M)
model.runtime: llama.cpp llama-server, local CPU only, no network calls at inference
model.note: A 3B model is used to exercise the protocol end-to-end in this environment. The proposed deployment envelope is open-weight models up to 36B on a single workstation.

metrics: miss rate: positives (UP/DOWN truth) not returned with the correct direction, over all positives; direction errors counted and reported separately
false-detection rate: NO_CHANGE truth returned as UP or DOWN, over all NO_CHANGE
agreement within the borderline band and within clear negatives, separately
routing_rule_registered_in_advance: In the proposed production design, cases in the borderline band are routed to human review by design. Therefore two evaluations are reported: (1) all sampled cases; (2) the auto-judged subset (positives + clear negatives) with coverage = auto-judged / all cases.
